name: Urban Beach Hotel
suitableFor: Couples wanting a small boutique stay
beachAccess: A few minutes' walk from the beach
confirmedFeatures: On-site bistro, cocktail menu, large beds, power showers, Egyptian cotton linen, TVs
overview: A 12-room boutique hotel on Argyll Road in Boscombe, a few minutes' walk from the beach. It is a sister property of the Urban Reef restaurant and has its own bistro serving locally sourced meat and fish.
surfTripFit: A short walk to the Boscombe seafront, with food and drink on site after a session.
